label: Ultrasonic sensor
description: Measures distance using the travel time of high-frequency reflected sound waves.

label: Infrared sensor
description: Senses infrared radiation; depending on the device, it measures reflectance or detects nearby objects.

label: LiDAR sensor
description: Uses laser light to estimate distances and create spatial scans of the environment.

label: RGB camera
description: Captures color images using red, green, and blue channels.

label: Depth camera
description: Estimates the distance to surfaces in a scene to support three-dimensional perception.

label: Inertial measurement unit
description: Combines accelerometers and gyroscopes to estimate motion and orientation.

label: Accelerometer
description: Measures specific acceleration along one or several axes.

label: Gyroscope
description: Measures angular velocity and supports orientation estimation and stabilization.

label: Encoder
description: Measures shaft rotation or displacement for odometry and velocity feedback.

label: Touch sensor
description: Detects physical contact, often in bumpers, switches, and collision systems.

label: Light sensor
description: Measures incoming light intensity to detect illumination changes.

label: Sonar
description: Detects objects or measures range using reflected acoustic waves.

label: Actuator
description: Converts a control command into physical force or motion.

label: Servomotor
description: A feedback-controlled actuator used to regulate position or rotational speed.

label: DC motor
description: An electric motor powered by direct current that converts electrical energy into rotation.

label: Stepper motor
description: Rotates in discrete angular steps in response to command pulses.

label: H-bridge
description: A power circuit that reverses current direction through a DC motor.

label: Pulse-width modulation
description: Controls average delivered power by varying the duty cycle of a switched signal.

label: Battery
description: Stores electrochemical energy and supplies voltage and current to the robot.

label: Mobile robot
description: Moves through its environment using wheels, tracks, legs, or other locomotion mechanisms.

label: NAO robot
description: A compact humanoid robot used in education, human-robot interaction, and robotics research.

label: Pioneer 3-AT
description: A four-wheel mobile robot platform for teaching and researching navigation and control.

label: TurtleBot
description: A family of educational and research mobile robots commonly integrated with ROS.

label: Humanoid robot
description: Has a body layout or motion capabilities resembling aspects of human anatomy.

label: Collaborative robot
description: An industrial robot intended for human-robot collaboration with appropriate safeguards.

label: Robotic manipulator
description: An articulated mechanism that positions and orients an end effector to perform tasks.

label: Forward kinematics
description: Computes end-effector pose from joint coordinates and robot geometry.

label: Inverse kinematics
description: Finds joint configurations that achieve a desired end-effector pose.

label: Odometry
description: Estimates robot displacement from measured motion, with errors that may accumulate over time.

label: SLAM
description: Simultaneous localization and mapping estimates robot pose while constructing or updating a map.

label: Robot localization
description: Estimates a robot position and orientation in a chosen reference frame.

label: Robot mapping
description: Constructs or updates a representation of the environment from sensor observations.

label: Path planning
description: Searches for a sequence of positions connecting start and goal while respecting constraints.

label: A-star algorithm
description: A heuristic graph search that combines accumulated path cost with estimated remaining cost.

label: Dijkstra algorithm
description: Computes shortest paths in a graph with nonnegative edge weights.

label: PID controller
description: Combines proportional, integral, and derivative terms to regulate a controlled variable.

label: Proportional control
description: Produces a control command proportional to the current reference error.

label: Feedback control
description: Uses measurements of system output to adjust subsequent control actions.

label: Reactive navigation
description: Selects actions from current observations without requiring a complete global plan.

label: Computer vision
description: Converts images and video into useful representations for perception and decision making.

label: OpenCV
description: An open-source library for computer vision and image processing.

label: Image segmentation
description: Partitions an image into meaningful regions or pixel classes.

label: Object detection
description: Identifies object categories and their locations in images.

label: YOLO
description: A family of object detectors that predicts object classes and bounding boxes from images.

label: Machine learning
description: Builds models that discover patterns from data rather than relying only on explicit rules.

label: Artificial neural network
description: A layered computational model with adjustable connection parameters learned from data.

label: Cognitive agent
description: Perceives input, maintains internal state, and chooses actions based on knowledge and goals.

label: Soar cognitive architecture
description: An architecture combining production rules, working memory, and long-term memory systems.

label: Procedural memory
description: In Soar, consists of productions mapping working-memory conditions to actions or preferences.

label: Semantic memory
description: In Soar, stores declarative knowledge independent of particular experiences and retrieves it by cues.

label: Episodic memory
description: In Soar, records past working-memory states and retrieves experience-related information by cues.

label: Working memory
description: Represents the current state, observations, and goals of the cognitive agent.

label: Soar production
description: A condition-action rule that matches working-memory patterns and proposes preferences or changes.

label: Decision cycle
description: A recurring sequence of elaboration, operator selection, and state update in the Soar architecture.

label: Flask
description: A lightweight Python framework for building web services and applications.

label: Python
description: A high-level programming language often used for robotics, automation, and education.

label: Webots
description: A robotics simulator with physics, sensors, actuators, and programmable controllers.

label: ROS 2
description: A set of libraries and tools for distributed robot systems using nodes, topics, and services.

label: ROS 2 node
description: A computational participant that publishes, subscribes, or provides communication services.

label: ROS 2 topic
description: A named publish-subscribe channel that carries messages among ROS 2 nodes.

label: Robot simulation
description: Uses a computational model of a robot and environment to test behaviors before physical deployment.

label: Calibration
description: Estimates or adjusts device parameters to better match reference measurements.

label: Kalman filter
description: Recursively estimates a system state under uncertainty using a model and measurements.

label: Sensor fusion
description: Combines measurements from multiple sensors to improve robustness of state estimation.

label: Obstacle
description: An object or region that restricts safe robot movement.

label: Robot safety
description: Practices that reduce risks to people, equipment, and the environment during robot operation.

label: Robot energy consumption
description: Energy used during locomotion, processing, sensing, and communication.

label: Internet of Things
description: Connected devices that exchange data for remote sensing, monitoring, and control.

label: Global Positioning System
description: A satellite-navigation system for estimating position when adequate signals are available.

label: Reinforcement learning
description: Learns a behavior policy using rewards observed through interaction with an environment.

label: Pepper robot
description: A humanoid social robot designed for interaction with people.

label: Differential-drive robot
description: A robot steered by independently controlling the speeds of its left and right wheels.

label: Omnidirectional robot
description: A mobile robot able to translate in multiple directions without first rotating its body.

label: Quadrotor drone
description: An aerial robot controlled by varying the thrust of four rotors.

label: Legged robot
description: A robot that locomotes using articulated limbs rather than continuous wheels or tracks.

label: Line following
description: A feedback task in which a robot tracks a floor marking using reflected-light sensors.

label: Wall following
description: A navigation method that maintains a target distance from a nearby wall.

label: Occupancy grid
description: A map divided into cells storing the estimated probability of being occupied.

label: Navigation costmap
description: A grid assigning traversal costs to cells to guide collision-aware planning.

label: Artificial potential fields
description: A reactive navigation method combining attraction to goals and repulsion from obstacles.

label: Rapidly-exploring random tree
description: A sampling-based motion-planning method that incrementally explores configuration space.

label: Admissible heuristic
description: A search heuristic that never overestimates the true remaining cost.

label: Local planner
description: A planner choosing short-horizon feasible motion commands using nearby obstacles and dynamics.

label: Global planner
description: A planner computing an overall route through a mapped environment.

label: Robot pose
description: A robots position and orientation relative to a reference frame.

label: Coordinate frame
description: A reference origin and axis convention used to express spatial quantities.

label: Homogeneous transformation
description: A matrix representation combining rigid-body rotation and translation.

label: Rotation matrix
description: An orthogonal matrix with unit determinant representing a three-dimensional rotation.

label: Quaternion
description: A four-component representation of three-dimensional orientation used to avoid some Euler-angle singularities.

label: Denavit-Hartenberg convention
description: A parameterization of adjacent robot-link transformations using four geometric parameters.

label: Revolute joint
description: A robotic joint producing relative rotation about one axis.

label: Prismatic joint
description: A robotic joint producing translation along one axis.

label: End effector
description: A tool attached to a robotic manipulator that interacts with objects or the environment.

label: Robot gripper
description: An end effector designed to grasp and release objects.

label: Torque
description: The rotational effect of force about an axis, measured in newton-meters.

label: Velocity control
description: A feedback scheme that drives measured speed toward a desired speed.

label: Position control
description: A feedback scheme that drives measured position toward a desired position.

label: Feedforward control
description: An anticipatory control action based on a reference or disturbance model.

label: Integral windup
description: An accumulation of integral-controller error that may cause overshoot under actuator saturation.

label: Deadband
description: An interval of input or error values that produces no control response.

label: Sampling rate
description: The number of measurements or control updates performed each second.

label: Nyquist sampling criterion
description: A band-limited signal must be sampled above twice its maximum frequency for ideal reconstruction.

label: Analog-to-digital converter
description: An electronic circuit converting an analog signal into a digital representation.

label: I2C bus
description: A synchronous serial communication bus often used for onboard sensors.

label: SPI bus
description: A synchronous serial bus for high-speed communication between microcontrollers and peripherals.

label: UART
description: An asynchronous serial interface that transfers data as timed bits without a shared clock.

label: MQTT
description: A lightweight publish-subscribe messaging protocol widely used in IoT systems.

label: Robot telemetry
description: Measurements and status data transmitted from a robot for observation and analysis.

label: Edge computing
description: Processing data near a robot or sensor rather than relying entirely on remote servers.

label: Cloud robotics
description: An approach using remote computing or shared services to extend robot capabilities.

label: Image classification
description: Assigning one or more class labels to an image.

label: Optical flow
description: Estimated apparent motion of image features between successive frames.

label: Canny edge detector
description: An image edge detector using smoothing, gradient analysis, and hysteresis thresholding.

label: Hough transform
description: A voting technique for detecting parameterized geometric structures such as lines and circles.

label: Image keypoint
description: A distinctive image location useful for matching and tracking.

label: ArUco marker
description: A square fiducial marker whose coded pattern supports detection and pose estimation.

label: AprilTag
description: A visual fiducial marker system supporting robust identification and pose estimation.

label: Point cloud
description: A set of three-dimensional points representing measured surfaces and geometry.

label: ROS 2 service
description: A request-response communication mechanism between ROS 2 nodes.

label: ROS 2 action
description: A ROS 2 communication pattern for long-running goals with feedback and cancellation.

label: Experimental reproducibility
description: The ability to repeat an experiment under documented conditions and obtain comparable observations.

label: Random seed
description: A value used to initialize a pseudo-random generator to reproduce the same sequence.

label: 95th-percentile latency
description: A response-time threshold at or below which 95 percent of observations fall.

label: Response accuracy
description: The proportion of evaluated responses matching a prespecified, independently checked reference.
